projects.title: Course Project on Library Test Coverage
bullets: Documented test failures and fixes for small open-source numerical utility libraries as part of a supervised undergraduate course project.
Measured branch coverage for the public numerical utility libraries using Python and pytest within the course project's assigned work.

research.title: Research Assistance on Tabular Query Performance
bullets: Loaded public bibliographic tables into a SQLite relational database as a student research assistant working under faculty supervision.
Wrote SQL aggregation and join queries for the bibliographic tables and documented query plans within the supervised query performance study.
